caption.zh: 颜色对比：浅黄字在白底上几乎看不见；红与绿只差色相，部分读者分不清
caption.en: Colour contrast: pale yellow text on white almost vanishes; red and green differ only in hue and some readers cannot tell them apart

caption.zh: 同样是 2 倍：只放大高度时看起来是 2 倍，边长一起放大时面积成了 4 倍
caption.en: The same factor of two: scaling only the height looks like 2x, scaling both sides makes the area 4x
